answer: The bamboo-splitter yard holds green culms stacked in rows, the froe and mallet ready on the bench. Proof of bamboo-splitter via cane split tally — a cane the bamboo-splitter splits only after 35 canes come out even without one splitting crooked, each cane split by the bamboo-splitter himself. ocean sets the froe at the end and drives it down the grain. dune pulls the strips apart and trims the nodes clean. quartz bundles the split canes and soaks them till they bend. Thirty-five canes must come out even without one splitting crooked, and the next still splinters where the culm ran dry.
